Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
I shall be very glad that [the Rubies of St Lo](../books.html#234) should be published as you propose, I receiving [/4 per copy](../others.html#160) sold.

Thanks for the two school Lances of Lynwood.[^1] I am only just come home from Devon or I should have written sooner

Yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: [The Lances of Lynwood](../books.html#23) had just been brought out in an abridged edition for schools (London: Macmillan 1894)
